title: C¹ co-area formula in parameter form (Simon Ch. 2, (6.3), (6.6), transported by a C¹ injective parametrization)
statement: Let m, k ∈ ℕ with m > 0 and k > 0, n := m + k, N ∈ ℕ, D ⊆ ℝⁿ open, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N of class C¹ on D and injective on D, and G : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ of class C¹. For u ∈ D let K(u) := ker DG(u), ι_{K(u)} its inclusion, and J(u) := normDet(Dψ(u) ∘ ι_{K(u)})·normDet(DG(u)*). Then for every Borel B ⊆ D and every Borel φ : ℝ^N → [0, ∞]: the function y ↦ ∫_{ψ(B ∩ G⁻¹{y})} φ dHᵏ is Lᵐ-a.e. measurable, and ∫_B φ(ψ(u))·J(u) dLⁿ(u) = ∫_{ℝᵐ} ∫_{ψ(B ∩ G⁻¹{y})} φ dHᵏ dLᵐ(y). Notation (as in the parent): ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); Hˢ = μHE[s] (applied to an arbitrary set it is the Hausdorff outer measure); Lᵈ = volume; normDet = Mathlib's LinearMap.normDet; P* = LinearMap.adjoint P; DF(u) = fderiv ℝ F u.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (D : Set (Rn (m + k))) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m), 0 < m → 0 < k → IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ D → InjOn ψ D → ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∀ B ⊆ D, MeasurableSet B → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun y : Rn m ↦ ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) volume ∧ ∫⁻ u in B, φ (ψ u) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ G u).toLinearMap).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G u).toLinearMap).normDet) = ∫⁻ y, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) ∂volume
